messages.subject: biomaRt shiny app deployment error
parts:

I am having a problem deploying a shiny app that runs queries with biomaRt. Is there something that needs to be specified in the app?

Uploading bundle for application: 80857...Warning: unable to access index for repository https://bioconductor.org/packages/3.2/bioc/src/contrib

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 140349641 error: Unhandled Exception: Repository must be specified for Bioconductor package source

Here is the beginning of my server.R script:

library(shiny)
library(biomaRt)

Best,
-Rob
